title: SIDESTORY: WHERE VERNAL WINDS WILL NEVER BLOW RERUN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: WHERE VERNAL WINDS WILL NEVER BLOW RERUN
DURATION: July 18, 2024, 10:00 - August 1, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: Where Vernal Winds Will Never Blow event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
EVENT STAGE DURATION:
[Case Investigation, Onsite]
[Criminal Pursuit, Offsite]
[Yumen Arena Board of Fame]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Yumen Arena Board of Fame] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARD: [★★★★★: Jieyun], Yumen Clinic Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, [Newly-Distilled Liedaozi], etc.
[The Swordsmith]
DURATION: July 18, 2024, 10:00 - August 1, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain [Newly-Distilled Liedaozi] by clearing event stages and completing [Yumen Arena Board of Fame] missions. [Newly-Distilled Liedaozi] can be used to redeem items from [The Swordsmith].
REWARDS: Jieyun's token, Yumen Clinic Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
NOTE:

The requirements to obtain certain medals for this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and met the adjusted requirements will receive the corresponding medals once logged in.
Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Side Story].
This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.

The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules] for more details.
[Intelligence Certificate Area] will be restocked as the event rerun begins. In addition, new redeemable will be added.
Operators Chongyue, Lin, Jieyun, and Firewhistle will gain more trust during the event rerun.
After the event ends, this event will be included in the [SideStory] permanently from August 1, 2024, 04:00 (UTC-7).
